description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the EmployeeEducationDao in the OrangeHRM project. It includes tests for CRUD operations and search functionalities related to employee education records within the HRMS system.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeEducationDao, testing CRUD and search functionalities related to employee education records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates an EmployeeEducationDao instance, and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of EmployeeEducation by ID, asserting the correctness of fetched data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple EmployeeEducation records by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests searching EmployeeEducation records with a filter, asserting count and instance type.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducationWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with a limit parameter, ensuring only the specified number of records are returned.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new EmployeeEducation record, verifying saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests editing an existing EmployeeEducation record and saving changes.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Tests obtaining the count of EmployeeEducation records matching a filter.
